item.title: ‘India has 100% more trade deals than Trump’: US media praises India-EU FTA while discussing how tariffs are hitting American citizens
item.description: The US media pointed out that the Trump administration has only been able to reach two trade agreements in ten months.

item.title: UGC Equity Regulations: How the draft was modified to incorporate Indira Jaising’s demands and left glaring questions on possible misuse to target general caste students
item.description: Unhappy with the 2025 regulations, Senior Advocate Indira Jaising proposed ten core reforms in the regulations, which made way into the final draft.

item.title: The illusion of 118% rise in caste discrimination complaints: How UGC data is being used to distort the caste discrimination debate
item.description: A headline-grabbing 118.4% rise, when stripped of institutional scale and context, turns limited data into a manufactured crisis to justify regulatory overreach.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh: Luring Hindus with money and miracles, Raisen police arrest husband-wife duo for illegal conversions; read what the FIR says
item.description: Police action followed protests over an alleged conversion racket operating through a prayer meeting in Satlapur. The FIR names the husband-wife duo and another accused, citing coercion, inducements and pressure to change religion.

item.title: SC puts a leash on unchecked Waqf Tribunal powers, limits jurisdiction to registered properties
item.description: The court observed that Sections 6(1) and 7(1) of the Waqf Act require that a property must be listed in the official auqaf list.

item.title: Canada looking towards India for trade to diversify business partners and reduce dependence on US: Trump’s tariff wars may result in another deal
item.description: Canada appears to be eager to repair the rift in diplomatic relations with India as its ties with the US continue to strain.

item.title: Who is Rahul Dewan, the Tech Entrepreneur who moved the Supreme Court against UGC Regulations?
item.description: Soon after filing the petition, Dewan spoke to OpIndia, explaining his concerns and the motivation behind moving the Supreme Court.

item.title: 24 instances when Saraswati Puja came under attack in 2026: Read how Islamists attacked the Hindu festival in India and Bangladesh
item.description: A couple of incidents of targeting of the Hindu festival and deities came to light in neighbouring Bangladesh, where Hindus are in the minority.

item.title: As Supreme Court stays UGC Regulations of 2026, read about the 2012 Rules that are currently in force and the key differences between them
item.description: The 2012 regulations did not limit the definition of discrimination to select caste groups only. However, the 2026 UGC guidelines explicitly left out General Category students. 'Caste-based discrimination' in the new regulation was defined as discrimination only on the basis of caste or tribe against the members of the scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, and other backward classes.

item.title: Himanta Biswa Sarma defends his “Miya Muslims” remark invoking SC comments on Bangladeshi infiltrators: Read how opposition and Islamo-leftists attacked him for saying the truth
item.description: Sarma has made it clear that the issue involves Assamese and illegal Bangladeshis, not Hindus and Muslims in Assam.
